title: ByteDance Launches Full-Duplex Large Model SeedRealtime, Domestic Computing Power Industry Chain Sentiment Intensifies

content_html:
ByteDance Seed has recently officially launched the native audio-video full-duplex large model SeedRealtime, marking a new step forward in its development of large models for comprehensive multimodal natural interaction.

According to the information, SeedRealtime adopts a unified architecture and naturally integrates audio, video, and text, enabling real-time interaction on continuous multimodal information streams, offering users a brand-new experience of "watching, listening, and speaking simultaneously."

Driven by the concentrated iteration and upgrading of domestic large models, market analysts believe that the logic of domestic computing power is continuously strengthening. Recently, several domestic large model companies, including DeepSeek, ByteDance Seedance, MiniMax, and Moonshot, have been upgrading intensively, achieving significant breakthroughs in video generation, full-modal interaction, and parameter scale.

content_html_zh:
字节跳动Seed近日正式推出原生音视频全双工大模型SeedRealtime，标志着其在综合多模态自然交互大模型开发上又迈出了新的一步。

据了解，SeedRealtime采用统一架构，将音频、视频、文本自然融合，实现连续多模态信息流的实时交互，为用户提供“边看边听边说”的全新体验。

在国产大机型集中迭代升级的推动下，市场分析人士认为，国产算力的逻辑正在不断强化。 近期，DeepSeek、字节跳动Seedance、MiniMax、Moonshot等国内几家大型模型公司密集升级，在视频生成、全模态交互、参数规模等方面取得重大突破。
